89:24.text: He will say: "Alas! Would that I had sent forth

89:25.text: So on that Day none will punish as He will punish.

89:27.text: (It will be said to the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism)

90:2.text: (from sin, and to punish the enemies of Islâm on the Day of the conquest)

90:4.text: Verily, We have created man in toil.

90:5.text: Does he think that none can overcome him?

90:7.text: Does he think that none sees him?

90:8.text: Have We not made for him two eyes,

90:9.text: And a tongue and two lips?

90:10.text: And shown him the two ways

90:11.text: But he has not attempted to pass on the path that is steep
(i.e. the path which will lead to goodness and success)

90:12.text: And what will make you know the path that is steep?

90:14.text: Or giving food in a day of hunger

90:15.text: To an orphan near of kin.

90:17.text: Then he became one of those who believed
and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and
recommended one another to pity and compassion.

90:18.text: They are those on the Right Hand

90:19.text: But those who disbelieved in Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
, they are those on the Left Hand

90:20.text: The Fire will be shut over them
The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.
